thread:
alice: anyone see odd provisional token counts from prefetch+reconnect on staging? noticed ~18 orphan tokens in ledger after a quick client reconnect.

ben: hmm. which flow? streaming? toolcalls?

alice: streaming + prefetch on the new router path. sequence: client opens stream, router prefetched a 4k prefix, client reconnects at ~1.2s, server resumed but ledger shows provisional entries for the prefetched bytes that never confirmed.

carla: can you paste the trace id + raw proto? billing-bot will try to reconcile.

alice: trace: Z4F-9123, snippet:
```
2026-03-15T16:03:20Z INFO router: prefetch bytes=4096 session=abc123 trace=Z4F-9123
2026-03-15T16:03:21Z WARN connection: client reconnect session=abc123 resume_offset=1200
2026-03-15T16:03:21Z INFO router: resume routed -> backend-b
2026-03-15T16:03:22Z ERROR ledger: provisional_write failed confirm_missing token_count=18 ledger_id=L-77
```

mike: looks like the resume path didn't carry the provisional->confirmed handshake to the original ledger owner. two ways: 1) router forgot to attach session token ownership during handoff, 2) backend didn't ack the confirm because it thought it was a duplicate.

ben: we added a short-circuit that prefers cheapest backend for prefetched segments. if handoff happens, we must transfer provisional ownership. maybe the short-circuit path doesn't set handoff=true.

olga: console UX note: customers keep asking why "confirmed tokens" vs "provisional tokens" counts differ after reconnects. can we show a small tooltip in usage breakdown that explains provisional lifecycle + a link to troubleshooting docs?

carla: on reconciliation: we could auto-detect orphan provisional tokens >30s and mark them for credit-back after double-checking no confirm arrived. need to be careful about race with late confirms.

billing-bot: reconciliation job queued: job_id=rec-20260315-77, scanning ledger L-77 for provisional>30s

ben: quick fix plan: (1) add explicit handoff flag to router path when prefetch used, (2) emit handoff.trace_id in ledger events, (3) reconcile orphaned provisional tokens nightly and expose counts in console. I'll open PR for 1+2.

alice: thanks. can we add an event-level telemetry tag so we can alert if orphan_rate > 0.1% of tokens over 1h? need a pager? not for now, just an infra alert to catch regressions.

mike: agree. set alert to sev-2 threshold in infra for canary only.

olga: I'll prototype the console tooltip copy and a small graph for provisional vs confirmed over time. want it in the troubleshooting dropdown.

carla: note: when reconciling, ensure we don't auto-credit if the session has subsequent confirms. need idempotent logic.

ben: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/438 (WIP) — adds handoff flag + ledger tag. will request review from mike and carla.

alice: filing a small internal runbook for on-call: steps to check trace, run recon job, and how to issue a manual credit. pinging @mike for oncall tweak :wave:

mike: got it. I'll add runbook entry and add test in canary that simulates mid-prefetch reconnect.

alice: thanks all :thumbsup:
